learning_extracted: The conflict-grade levers ENGAGE on the GAP-A-ready foraging substrate: Factor A graded-k and Factor B gap-scaled commit-T both vary across P1 ticks on 3/3 seeds. Implementation is live, not inert.

ARM_A1B1 committed-action entropy lifts strictly above BOTH the collapsed-proposer baseline AND the matched-noise control on 2/3 seeds (C_PRIMARY pass) -- a partial positive signal that conflict-grading moves committed behaviour -- but it is FRAGILE (one genuine seed, one near-zero technical pass on a monostrategy-collapsed seed, one regression) and is NOT the load-bearing falsifier.

The load-bearing C_FGAP falsifier (is the lift gap-CONCENTRATED = real conflict-grading, or uniform = a bigger fixed shortlist / hotter flat softmax) is UNCOMPUTABLE on this substrate: the foraging top-F gap is pinned in the near-tie bin (<=2 populated bins, slope needs >=3), so the entropy-vs-gap regression has no x-axis spread.

The near-tie F-gap concentration is itself a manifestation of the F-dominance MECH-439 asserts -- the experiment design did not anticipate that the phenomenon under test would collapse the gap-distribution its own falsifier depends on.

The self-route's prescription ('re-queue at higher P0') is misdirected: more training cannot open an ecology-pinned gap; the fix is a measurement/test-design redesign (gap-blind control arms), not more compute.

Generalisable readiness-gate lesson: the grading-non-vacuity precondition bundled 'levers engaged' (k/T_eff vary) with 'falsifier computable' (gap spans >=3 bins). These should be SEPARATE gates -- a levers-engaged + falsifier-uncomputable run should route to measurement-redesign, never substrate_not_ready_requeue.

redesign_spec.spec: Add FIXED-k_max and FIXED-peak-T control arms (matched magnitude, gap-BLIND) so the 'gap-concentrated lift vs uniform lift' distinction is tested by an ARM CONTRAST instead of the uncomputable per-gap-bin regression. ARM_A1B1 (gap-SCALED both levers) vs ARM_FIXED_KMAX (k pinned at k_max=6, gap-blind) and ARM_FIXED_HOT_T (T pinned at the peak base+alpha=2.5, gap-blind, distinct from matched_noise which keeps the collapsed proposer source). conflict-grade is load-bearing iff ARM_A1B1 beats BOTH gap-blind controls -- if a fixed-large-k / fixed-hot-T lifts entropy as much as the gap-scaled version, the lift is NOT conflict-grading.
supporting_mechanisms: Quantile-adaptive gap binning (bin by gap quantiles matched to the near-tie-dominated distribution, so even a concentrated gap yields >=3 populated bins) -- retains the regression falsifier as a secondary readout.
Decouple the readiness gate: separate 'levers engaged' (k/T_eff vary) from 'gap-spread for the regression'. levers-engaged + regression-uncomputable should NOT self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue.
redesign_spec.non_vacuity_preserved: Keep the route-range + e2-divergence + levers-engaged (k/T_eff vary) readiness gates; below floor still self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (never a false weakens).
